title: Construction of the finite polynomial translation system
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a normed field $E$ with a normed $\mathbf Q_\ell$-algebra structure and finite dimension over $\mathbf Q_\ell$, and integers $k,m\geq0$. Then there exists a PolynomialSystem for $(\ell,E,k,m)$ [def-sfb-polynomial-rank-one-model-data]. In particular its stages are identified with exactly the degree-at-most-n polynomial spaces, its operator is minus the first partial derivative, its exponent is n+1, and its action is the specified negative translation. This assertion constructs only the finite system; it does not assert an internal scalar-extended colimit presentation.

proof.text: Write $q=r+m$ and $I_n=\{a\in\mathbf N^q:\sum_i a_i\leq n\}$. Every coordinate of $a\in I_n$ is at most $n$, so $I_n$ is finite. By the coefficient description in [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring], the monomials $x^a$ for $a\in I_n$ are a basis of $V_n$. Thus $V_n$ is finite-dimensional, the inclusions are injective, and their matrices are the coordinate inclusions. Every monomial belongs to $I_n$ for its total degree; no uniform degree bound is imposed.

source.place: Paragraph (3), open direct image: agent expansion of the finite polynomial translation filtration below the coefficient comparison.

proof.text: For a translation parameter $u=(t,g_2,\ldots,g_r)$, repeated use of [lem-pur-commutative-ring-binomial-expansion] gives, for $a=(a_1,\ldots,a_r)$ and spectator exponent $b$, $$\rho_n(u)(y^az^b)=\sum_{0\leq c_i\leq a_i}\left(\prod_{i=1}^r\binom{a_i}{c_i}(-u_i)^{a_i-c_i}\right)y^cz^b.$$ Every displayed exponent has total degree at most $|a|+|b|$, so this defines an endomorphism of $V_n$ and agrees across inclusions. Substituting twice gives $f(y-u-v,z)$; substituting zero gives $f$. Hence these are linear automorphisms with inverse parameter $-u$, satisfying the representation law and equivariance of the transitions.

source.place: Paragraph (3), open direct image: agent expansion of the finite polynomial translation filtration below the coefficient comparison.

proof.text: The entries in the preceding finite matrix are polynomial functions of $u$. The coordinate isomorphism $V_n\cong E^{I_n}$ and its inverse are continuous by [lem-sfb-finite-dimensional-linear-map-continuous]: $E$ is a complete nontrivially normed finite extension of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ and $V_n$ is finite-dimensional Hausdorff. The coordinates of $u\in\mathbf Z_\ell^r$ are continuous into $E$. Finite sums and products are continuous in this topological field. Consequently $(u,v)\mapsto\rho_n(u)v$ is jointly continuous, and $u\mapsto\rho_n(u)$ is continuous in the finite matrix topology. This checks continuity of the representation, rather than only continuity for fixed $u$.

source.place: Paragraph (3), open direct image: agent expansion of the finite polynomial translation filtration below the coefficient comparison.

proof.text: Use the explicit monomial derivative of [def-weil-pbc-polynomial-partial-derivative]. If $k$ is the exponent of $y_1$ in a monomial $w=y_1^k w_0$, with $w_0$ independent of $y_1$, then $$D_n^jw=(-1)^j k(k-1)\cdots(k-j+1)y_1^{k-j}w_0\quad(0\leq j\leq k),\qquad D_n^jw=0\quad(j>k).$$ This follows by induction on $j$, starting with the empty product at $j=0$. Since $k\leq n$, $D_n^{n+1}=0$. The derivative lowers degree, hence preserves $V_n$ and commutes with its inclusions. The $G$-substitutions change only variables in $w_0$, so differentiating before or after them gives the same expression. This proves commutation with $G$, including its identity-only case $r=1$.

source.place: Paragraph (3), open direct image: agent expansion of the finite polynomial translation filtration below the coefficient comparison.

proof.text: Dividing the preceding formula by $j!$ is permitted in the characteristic-zero field $E$. For $w=y_1^k w_0$ the Taylor sum is $$\sum_{j=0}^n\frac{t^jD_n^jw}{j!}=\sum_{j=0}^k\binom{k}{j}(-t)^j y_1^{k-j}w_0=(y_1-t)^kw_0,$$ by [lem-pur-commutative-ring-binomial-expansion]. Extend by linearity to $V_n$. With $e_n=n+1>0$, all conditions of [def-sfb-ind-unipotent-system] are now checked: finite dimension, positive nilpotence exponent, injective intertwining transitions, continuity, commutation and the specified exponential identity.
